description: This PHP class, MailTransformer, is part of the Goteo project and is responsible for transforming a Mail model object into a structured format, providing methods to retrieve various properties and statistics related to emails such as status, subject, language, receivers, sent/failed counts, and success percentage.

classes.name: MailTransformer
classes.description: A transformer class that converts a Mail model into a format suitable for presentation or further processing, offering methods to access mail properties and statistics.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the email model.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Retrieves the subject of the email.

methods.name: getPercent
methods.description: Returns an HTML span element displaying the percentage related to email status, styled with a hue based on the percentage value.

methods.name: getLang
methods.description: Returns the language code of the email.

methods.name: getReceivers
methods.description: Provides the list of receivers for the email.

methods.name: getSent
methods.description: Returns the count or status indicator for sent emails.

methods.name: getFailed
methods.description: Returns information about failed email deliveries.

methods.name: getPending
methods.description: Returns the count or status of pending emails.

methods.name: getSuccess
methods.description: Returns an HTML span with the percentage of emails opened, styled with a hue based on the percentage.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Generates a URL link based on the type and key; primarily returns a detail link for the subject.
